mentions.name: Margarita
mentions.description: A markdown-based language for writing and controlling coding agents. It provides two file formats: .mg, a templating language that renders dynamic prompts to Markdown with variables, conditionals, loops, and includes; and .mgx, an agent scripting language that extends .mg with agentic execution including state, memory, tool calls, and user input.
mentions.problem: Controlling coding agents is cumbersome; the project aims to let you write agents as easily as writing markdown.
mentions.audience: People writing and controlling coding agents; the author notes uncertainty about usefulness now that most people just use Claude Code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Margarita provides two file formats:

.mg — A templating language that renders dynamic prompts to Markdown. Extends Markdown with variables, conditionals, loops, and includes.

.mgx — An agent scripting language that extends .mg with agentic execution: state, memory, tool calls, user input, and more.
